mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 3.8% in the past month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 3.8%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential investment (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and INDPRO decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 285) and aggressive monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy actions lead to reduced equity valuations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 285 and FEDFUNDS > 3.0, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (HOUST) over the past two months signals strong consumer demand for housing, which correlates with higher consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases over the prior two months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 (index 2017=100) in the past two months, it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 3.5%), wage pressures accelerate inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past two months signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases over the prior two months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.
